The '''Koba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Cerean Reach/Legends|Cerean Reach]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the planet [[Koba]].
